When the doctor speaks, women stop, watch and follow.

Cost per message€1.70

143 messages for €242.85. Average of previous ads: ~€4.

Gyno Center Kosova is the gynecology clinic of Dr. Jehona Binishi Hysa in Prishtina. In the first month we built the content around real patient questions, with the doctor on camera, and brought the ads down to €10 a day.
